decisions.reason: Correcting the ESP32 breakout pitch does not change the defined three-board or integrated-board architecture.
The breakout pitch correction does not alter antenna placement, direction, or keepout requirements.
The source changes only the ESP32 breakout pitch and does not revise board orientation or connector-placement constraints.
The separate-board connector-placement rules are unaffected by the integrated-board ESP32 breakout pitch correction.
No enclosure dimension, mounting, access, ventilation, or component-retention requirement is changed by the breakout pitch correction.
Although breakout-hole geometry can affect routing, the source does not necessarily change the candidate's current board-dimension or content-fit state.
The ESP32 breakout pitch applies to the main or integrated board and does not affect the power board's mechanical constraints.
The sensor board's component-fit requirement is independent of the ESP32 breakout pitch.
The breakout pitch correction does not change the power board's layer count or grounding strategy.
The source preserves a through-hole breakout while correcting its pitch; it does not change the connector mounting technology.
The ESP32 breakout pitch does not alter any interboard power connector, pinout, or topology attribute.
The corrected 1.27 mm ESP32 breakout pitch is distinct from the interboard signal connectors and their specified 1.25 mm pitch.
